decision_notes: Thresholds manually reviewed using the v2 resequenced QC distributions. RNA minimum reduced from the automated suggestion of 500 to 300 because nuclei with 300-499 UMIs generally retained adequate gene complexity and passed independent QC metrics, whereas most nuclei with 200-299 UMIs failed the 250-feature criterion. ATAC minimum reduced from 1000 to 500 because nuclei with 500-999 ATAC counts generally retained strong TSS enrichment and FRiP. The v2-specific upper RNA, feature, and ATAC thresholds were retained from the sample-aware suggestions; the higher ATAC maximum reflects the increased depth obtained from ATAC resequencing. Mitochondrial, TSS enrichment, nucleosome signal, and FRiP thresholds were retained as broad quality bounds.
